description: Political & Climate Transition Risk — two forward-looking structural risk endpoints bundled. (1) political-risk: regime stability, policy risk, and sanctions exposure across major economies — structured assessment of political disruption to cross-border payment corridors. (2) transition-risk: climate policy transition risk across industries and geographies — carbon price exposure, stranded asset risk, policy velocity, regulatory tightening signals. Critical for SFDR Article 8/9 compliance and climate-adjusted settlement pricing. GET, no input required. $0.75 USDC (bundled rate). Data: ACLED, FRED, World Bank WGI. 6h cache.
